about_the_game:
Step into the role of Guild Master in HeroField: Game Craft, a fantasy RPG where strategy, resource management, and endless adventure collide. Your journey begins with a single hero, but through training, equipment, and careful leadership, you’ll forge an unstoppable guild to conquer a procedurally generated dungeon filled with peril and opportunity.

Every floor brings challenging trials—ferocious enemies with unique skills, devious traps, and hidden treasures waiting to be claimed. Victory rewards you with gold and monster materials, fueling a deep crafting system. Craft weapons, armor, and accessories with hundreds of possible recipes, each granting unique attributes to shape your heroes’ power.

Beyond the dungeon, your guild flourishes. Take on bounties that challenge your strength while offering rich rewards. Recruit fresh talent at the Hero Board, with ranks from Standard to Legendary that determine strength, resilience and potential. As heroes level up, they grow ever stronger, giving each hero a distinct role in your strategy.

The Ascension system allows your greatest champions to rise even higher. By sacrificing other heroes of the same rank, a max-level hero can ascend, resetting their level but permanently boosting their stats—an endless cycle of growth and refinement.

Once you clear floor 2, Unlimited Mode unlocks. Here, the challenge never ends—push your party’s limits, scale the infinite depths, and prove your mastery on the global leaderboard.

“Crafting Tokens — a rare premium currency that drops in battle, powering legendary recipes and premium skips. No timers, no microtransactions — earn your premium through play.”

With deep crafting, strategic hero management, and infinite replayability, HeroField: Game Craft delivers a rich, ever-evolving fantasy experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz) or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound
